newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VENDEX SAYS KBB SELL-OFF TO GO AHEAD.
newsitem.headline: VENDEX SAYS KBB SELL-OFF TO GO AHEAD.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Friday afternoon it would go ahead with the Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer sell-off, despite the fall in KBB shares.
"It is a commercial decision to go ahead with the sell-off," said a Vendex spokesman, adding he did not know if Vendex had set a bottom for the price it would sell KBB shares.
The Vendex spokesman said the book value of its stake in KBB was about 350 million guilders. Vendex currently owns 36 percent of the 11.8 million shares outstanding.
KBB slipped another 2.50 guilders to 126.00 in mid-afternoon on Friday after shedding nearly 10 percent, or 13.50 guilders, on Thursday after a profit warning.
Earlier today Vendex said it was reviewing the sale, which was announced last Tuesday.
"We are confident the sell-off will go well," the spokesman said.
The KBB sell-off was due to be realised within two weeks in an international placement carried out by a syndicate led by Morgan Stanley.
